Small multiples on parallel planes

Source: R/facet-slices.R
facet_slices_3d.Rd

Splits the data by one or more variables, like ggplot2::facet_wrap(), and draws the subsets on parallel planes stacked along one axis of a single 3D panel, one translucent plane per subset, as matplotlib stacks 2D polygons and bars at several depths of one 3D axes. Statistics and position adjustments run within each slice, so a histogram or a smooth is computed for every subset; layers whose data lack the slicing variables are repeated in every slice.

Usage

facet_slices_3d(
  facets,
  along = "z",
  planes = TRUE,
  labels = TRUE,
  fill = "grey85",
  colour = "grey60",
  alpha = 0.35
)

Arguments

facets

Slicing variables: ggplot2::vars(), a one-sided formula such as ~ year, or a character vector of column names.

along

Axis the slices are stacked along: "z", "y" or "x".

planes

Whether to draw the translucent planes.

labels

Whether to label each plane with its slice.

fill, colour, alpha

Fill, outline colour and opacity of the planes.

Value

An object to add to a plot with +: the facet, the plane layer (drawn first) and the label layer.

Details

The slice's position is set on the along aesthetic of every layer, so the layers draw with the other two: with along = "z" ordinary x/y layers lie on horizontal planes, and coord_3d(up = "y") turns those planes upright, one behind the other. A single numeric slicing variable places the slices at its values on a continuous scale; otherwise the slices sit at the levels of a discrete scale, in the order of factor levels or sorted values. Each plane carries its label, as a facet strip does.

See also

annotation_plot_3d() for one whole 2D plot on a plane.

Examples

d <- data.frame(year = rep(c(2000, 2010, 2020), each = 150),
  x = rnorm(450, mean = rep(c(0, 0.5, 1), each = 150)))
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x)) +
  ggplot2::geom_density(fill = "steelblue", alpha = 0.6) +
  facet_slices_3d(~year) +
  coord_3d(up = "y", azimuth = 30, elevation = 20)
ggplot2::ggplot(d, ggplot2::aes(x)) +
  ggplot2::geom_histogram(bins = 15, position = "identity", fill = "grey60") +
  facet_slices_3d(~year, along = "z") +
  coord_3d()
